name: Separator
description: A visual divider between content sections. Built on Radix UI Separator primitive. Renders as a 1px line that adapts orientation between horizontal (full width) and vertical (full height).

props.name: orientation
props.description: The orientation of the separator. Horizontal renders as h-[1px] w-full; vertical renders as h-full w-[1px].

props.name: decorative
props.description: When true, the separator is purely visual and hidden from the accessibility tree. When false, it is announced as a separator to assistive technologies.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes. Merged with default 'shrink-0 bg-border' styling.

props.name: asChild
props.description: When true, merges props onto the child element instead of rendering a default element.

accessibility.role: separator (when decorative is false) or none/presentation (when decorative is true)
accessibility.keyboard: Not interactive; no keyboard handling required.
accessibility.aria: When decorative is false, role=separator is applied with aria-orientation matching the orientation prop. When decorative is true, role=none is applied.
accessibility.notes: Use decorative={false} when the separator conveys meaningful structural information, such as between distinct page sections.
